ingredients.name: Dark chocolate chips or semi-sweet milk chocolate chips
ingredients.originalText: 225 g 50-70% dark chocolate chips or semi-sweet milk chocolate chips

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 230 g melted butter (2 sticks); 330 g bread flour; 5 g salt; 5 g baking soda; 100-200 g white sugar; 100-200 g brown sugar; 1 egg; 15 g milk; 5 g vanilla; 225 g 50-70% dark chocolate chips or semi-sweet milk chocolate chips. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Mix the flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl
Using a mixer or whisk, beat the butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk in a separate bowl for a few mins
Combine and stir in the dry ingredients, then the chocolate chips

Use an ice cream scooper or spoon to make uniform balls of cookie dough to the size you like and evenly space them out on a parchment paper lined baking sheet (you may need more than one sheet depending on the size of the cookies)
Bake in the oven one baking sheet at a time for around 8-10 minutes, taking them out when they start to brown
Cool for a few minutes then put them on a cooling rack

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: mfed3
source.originalInstructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F
2. Mix the flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl
3. Using a mixer or whisk, beat the butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk in a separate bowl for a few mins
4. Combine and stir in the dry ingredients, then the chocolate chips
5. Use an ice cream scooper or spoon to make uniform balls of cookie dough to the size you like and evenly space them out on a parchment paper lined baking sheet (you may need more than one sheet depending on the size of the cookies)
6. Bake in the oven one baking sheet at a time for around 8-10 minutes, taking them out when they start to brown
7. Cool for a few minutes then put them on a cooling rack
